notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Corridor Monitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.
